name: reckon
description: Reckon - local-first desktop app with cloud sync

scripts.bundle:server: pnpm --filter @reckon/server build && node -e "require('fs').rmSync('apps/desktop/server-bundle',{recursive:true,force:true})" && pnpm --filter @reckon/server deploy --prod --legacy --config.confirmModulesPurge=false apps/desktop/server-bundle && node -e "require('fs').rmSync('apps/desktop/server-bundle/node_modules/.pnpm/node_modules/@reckon/server',{force:true})"
scripts.package:desktop: pnpm bundle:server && pnpm --filter @reckon/shared build && node apps/desktop/scripts/materialize-shared.cjs && pnpm --filter @reckon/desktop package
